The `style` (which is `console.get_style(self.style)`) is the general style of the panel, including the background.
The title should probably be stylized with `style` (the panel style) as well as `partial_border_style` (the border style).

If `border_style = style + partial_border_style`, then the title should probably be stylized with `border_style`.

The title is part of the border. So it should have the border style, which includes the panel background.
